summary: Iteration 25 - Testing bug fixes for FamFocus Hub. All 5 main fixes verified: 1) Welcome page has no logo, 2) Child login works with testkid/pass123, 3) Child login redirects to /setup-wizard for first_login=true, 4) WebSocket URL correctly includes /api prefix, 5) Family Wall poll component receives familyMembers prop for voter names.

minor.issue: Response uses 'type' field instead of 'post_type' - inconsistent naming

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket shows 'Reconnecting...' because session token is stored in localStorage but WebSocket code looks for it in cookies. The WebSocket URL is correctly set to /api/ws/chat/{token}, but the token retrieval from cookies fails when using dev-login (which stores in localStorage).
integration_issues.note: This is expected behavior for dev-login flow. Real Google OAuth login sets the cookie properly.
